probability.title: The Probability Carnival
probability.subtitle: Where the monsters know what's likely to happen

booths.title: The carnival gate
booths.intro: 🎪 **Welcome to the Probability Carnival!** Three monster friends run the games here: 👾 Pinky, 🐙 Marina and 🦄 Goldie. At the gate they play a guessing game: will it happen? Some things CAN'T happen, some things are FOR SURE, and lots of things are… maybe! Sort each card into the right booth.

events.dragon: A real dragon will buy cotton candy
events.sevenDie: You'll roll a 7 on a regular die
events.pinkSpin: The wheel will land on pink next spin
events.friend: You'll make a new friend at the carnival
events.catTalks: A cat will start talking in people-words

booths.retry: Hmm, think again — CAN it happen? MUST it happen?
booths.done: You speak probability now: impossible, maybe, for sure! 🌟

spinner.title: The Great Wheel
spinner.intro: 🎡 **👾 Pinky's Great Wheel!** Look at the slices: pink is huge, teal is smaller, gold is tiny. Pick the color you think the wheel will land on, then SPIN! Watch closely — is every color equally easy to hit?
spinner.pickPrompt: Pick your color, then spin the wheel!
spinner.landedMatch: 🎉 It landed on your pick! What luck!
spinner.landedMiss: It landed on {{color}} this time — nobody can know for sure!
spinner.whichEasiest: 🤔 Pinky asks: which color is EASIEST for the wheel to land on?
spinner.easyCorrect: Exactly! The pink slice is the biggest, so pink happens most often. Spin a bit more!
spinner.easyRetry: Look at the wheel — whose slice takes up the most space?
spinner.done: A bigger slice means a bigger chance — even when nobody knows the next spin! ✨

eggs.title: Marina's egg machine
eggs.intro: 🥚 **🐙 Marina's monster-egg machine!** Behind the glass you can COUNT the eggs of every color. That's the whole secret of chance: more eggs of a color, more chance it pops out. Answer Marina's questions — every right answer wins you an egg!

questions.most: Which color egg is MOST likely to pop out?
questions.least: Which color egg is LEAST likely to pop out?
questions.compare: Pink or teal — which is more likely to pop out?
questions.canGold: Can a gold egg pop out of this jar?

eggs.retry: Count the eggs of each color — which pile is bigger?
eggs.done: More of a kind means more likely — you can SEE chance by counting! 🥚✨

tally.title: The tally tent
tally.intro: 📊 **🦄 Goldie's tally tent!** One spin can surprise you. But what happens after LOTS of spins? Goldie will spin the Great Wheel 40 times and chart every landing. First — predict: which color will win the most?
tally.predictPrompt: Before we start: which color do you think will win the most?
tally.keepSpinning: Spin, spin! Watch the bars grow…
tally.wildStart: Whoa — pink isn't winning?! Small numbers love surprises. Keep spinning!
tally.settling: Look — the chart is starting to look like the wheel…
tally.whichWon: 40 spins! Now read YOUR chart: which color won the most?
tally.wonRetry: Look at the bars — which one is tallest?
tally.matchWheel: Your tally chart grew into the shape of the wheel — big slice, tall bar!
tally.done: Lots of tries reveal the true chances. One spin is a surprise; forty spins tell the truth! 📊
tally.doneGoodGuess: And that's the color you predicted — great thinking! Lots of tries reveal the true chances. 📊

fair.title: Fair or rigged?
fair.intro: 🕵️ **You're the Carnival Inspector!** The monsters invented new wheel games, and some are sneaky. Read each game's rule, look at the slices, and stamp it: FAIR if every player has the same chance — RIGGED if someone's slice is bigger. Even if the lucky one is YOU!

games.g1: You win on 👾 pink, Pinky wins on 🐙 teal.
games.g2: Pinky wins on 👾 pink, you win on 🐙 teal.
games.g3: You win on 🐙 teal, Marina wins on 👾 pink.
games.g4: YOU win on 👾 pink, Marina wins on 🐙 teal. Lucky you…?
games.g5: Three players: one wins on 👾 pink, one on 🐙 teal, one on 🦄 gold.

fair.retry: Check the slices again — does every player get the same amount of wheel?
fair.retryHint2: Count the slices for each player. Same size = fair. Different size = rigged — even when it helps you!
fair.done: The monsters cheer their honest inspector: a fair game gives everyone the same chance! 🕵️✨

skills.words: I can tell impossible, maybe, and certain apart
skills.bigSlice: A bigger slice means a bigger chance
skills.compare: More of a kind means more likely
skills.longRun: Lots of tries reveal the true chances
skills.fair: A fair game gives everyone the same chance

probability.finished: You discovered two great secrets: chance can be SEEN — in slices and piles and tall bars — and even when nobody knows the next spin, lots of spins tell the truth. The monsters wave goodbye… come back and beat the wheel again! 🎪✨
